description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinairySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event, along with related utility classes and functions, for use within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and platform-specific synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A platform-independent critical section class providing mutual exclusion.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore with a binary state, used for synchronization.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore that maintains a count, allowing multiple threads to synchronize based on resource availability.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: An event object for thread synchronization, supporting manual and automatic reset modes.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template class providing RAII-style locking for synchronization objects.
